text:
Lina (People Ops): Quick heads up — orientation moved to Monday 10:30 AM PT / 6:30 PM GMT. I sent updated invites to the new-hires group; Zoom link + agenda are in the event.
Omar: Thanks Lina. Does the session include the account setup walkthrough and badge/SSO steps?
Lina (People Ops): Yes — agenda: intros, access checklist walkthrough, security + SSO, benefits Q&A. We'll record and add captions.
Hannah: I'm CET so 6:30 PM is fine. Will the recording be uploaded somewhere central?
Lina (People Ops): Recorded to company Zoom and uploaded to the onboarding Notion page. I'll attach the recording to the calendar event and post the Notion link here after the meeting.
Riku: I'm JST so it's late for me. Will there be an APAC-friendly live repeat or just the recording?
Lina (People Ops): We'll run a second APAC-friendly live session next Thursday at 7:00 AM PT / 11:00 PM JST with a short live Q&A. I'll label it "APAC-friendly" in the calendar and include buddy assignments in the description.
it-bot: Reminder: complete SSO + MFA before orientation to avoid access delays. Setup guide: https://intranet.company.com/it/mfa.
Omar: Can we get timestamps in the recording (setup / benefits / security)? Makes rewatching easier.
Lina (People Ops): Good idea — we'll add timestamps in Notion and put jump links in the calendar description.
calendar-bot: Meeting updated: "New Hire Orientation  Cohort" Mon 2025-04-21 10:30:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/3216549870. Recording will be posted to https://drive.company.com/orientation-recordings.
Hannah: Also request captions please; captions + transcript would be great.
Lina (People Ops): We'll enable Zoom auto-captions and upload a timestamped transcript. If auto-captions fail, we'll add a manual transcript.
Omar: If someone needs an .ics for another client, can calendar-bot attach one? My manager uses Outlook.
calendar-bot: Reply with `ics me` in thread and I'll DM the file.
Lina (People Ops): I'll post the APAC invite link and the Notion pre-reads in this thread once created. If you don't get the invites, DM me and I'll send a direct invite in your timezone. See you there (or on the replay)!
